svg.text: claudia creates — E10.31 Save as template: add it to the server's templates, or save the file
Mock round of 25 Nov 2026, for review. Content is invented. Agreed in the grill: anyone who may make documents can add; the person who added a template can replace or remove it,
an administrator can remove any; adding is a library event, not an export; the dialog still offers the file.
O · Format ▸ Template ▸ Save as Template…
Two ways to keep it. Adding puts it in File ▸ New for everyone on this server.
A 20-minute talk: one idea per slide, a few strong pictures.
Keeps this presentation without its slides: its 8 layouts and its theme (24 styles, palette).
Adding makes it visible to everyone on this server. You can replace or remove it later.
In words, under the name. Replace only for your own.
There is a template called Conference talk.
Replace it with this presentation, or choose another name.
There is a template called Conference talk.
Ana Weber added “Conference talk” on 21 Nov.
Choose another name. Only the person who added a template
replaces it; an administrator can remove it.
It is there at once; nothing else changes in this deck.
“Conference talk” is in this server’s templates.
Everyone who may make presentations finds it under File ▸ New. You added it, so you can replace it
by saving again under the same name, or remove it from its card in File ▸ New.
R · File ▸ New: your own templates can be removed
Added by you on the card; Remove asks once. Other people's cards have no Remove.
5 layouts · English · added by Ana Weber
S · Server settings ▸ Templates (administrator): who added each one
A new column. An administrator removes any added template; the built-in one cannot be removed. Adding by file stays for those who prefer it.
A 20-minute talk, one idea per slide
A formal briefing with a decision
Removing a template never changes presentations made from it. A person who added one removes it from its card in File ▸ New.
